description: Repo-level exceptions to the shared preset. Each rule names the compatibility constraint it protects; remove the rule when the constraint clears.
The TypeScript 7 compiler runs beside the TypeScript 6 API alias required by typescript-eslint. Override selectors stay protected from unsafe cross-major rewrites.

packageRules.description: typescript-eslint requires the TypeScript 6 programmatic API. Keep the dependency named typescript on @typescript/typescript6 while the separately aliased typescript-7 package supplies the tsc binary.

The ajv@<7 and nanoid@<4 selectors in pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides deliberately pin those old majors for consumers that need them (ajv 7 rewrote its API; nanoid 4+ is ESM-only). Bumping the override value across the major boundary breaks them at runtime, not at install.
